newsitem.title: ISRAEL: No results on Plasson's London IPO before Friday.
newsitem.headline: No results on Plasson's London IPO before Friday.

text.p: The results of the initial public offering in Israel's Plasson Plastic Products will not be announced until Friday at the earliest, sources close to the offering said on Thursday.

Plasson, a kibbutz-owned maker of plastic products, is raising 20 million pounds in the first-ever offering by an Israeli company on the London Stock Exchange. Officials at Plasson could not be reached for commment.

The offering comes after another Israeli company, Nechustan Metals, chose to delay its IPO in response to investor nervousness in the wake of violent clashes last week between Israelis and Palestinians.

Plasson, whose offering is being sponsored by Societe Generale Strauss Turnbull, had orignally planned to go public last June. It delayed the offering due to market nervousness following the election of hardliner Benjamin Netanyahu as prime minister in May.
